title: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health. This view deserves our serious attention, especially when modern life keeps us under constant pressure and quiet mental troubles often go unnoticed. To begin with, ignoring our inner state can cost us dearly. Long-term stress and anxiety lead to sleeplessness and poor concentration, which in turn damage both our bodies and our performance. Take my own experience as an example: before an important exam, I was so anxious that I could not sleep for nights and ended up doing far worse than usual. Only after I talked to my friends and kept a regular routine did my mind settle down and my results recover. This taught me that the mind clearly deserves the same care we give the body. In conclusion, we should value our minds as much as our bodies. Only when individuals pay attention to their feelings and society offers more support can we truly live a healthy and balanced life.
keyPoints: 抄句后接钩子。首句逐字照抄给定句 Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health.，紧接一句 This view deserves our serious attention 点题，落实了「抄句后立刻接钩子」，把给定句接成自己的论证起点。

理由加例子。本段照「主题句→理由→例子→小结」展开：To begin with, ignoring our inner state can cost us dearly 是主题句，随后给失眠、注意力下降的理由，再用 Take my own experience as an example 引出考试焦虑亲历，最后 This taught me that... 回扣中心，兑现了「理由加 例子撑满一段」。
重申加呼吁。结尾仅两句：In conclusion, we should value our minds as much as our bodies 重申立场、呼应 as much attention as physical health；Only when... can we 句呼吁个人与社 会共同行动，收得简短利落，未再展开新例。
